BiblicalUsage: Tsalaph — Zalaph — is named once, as the father of Hanun, who repaired another piece of Jerusalem's wall. He is one of the many fathers named only because a son built. His name is kept because his son's work is kept.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God remembers the fathers behind the builders, even when only one verse carries their name. Zalaph's place in the record is his son's faithfulness.
